does_not_establish: that the law fits any astronomical response
a conserved action or Maxwell-sector completion
an explanation of cosmological redshift, dark matter, galaxy rotation, or matter capture
establishes: a minimal covariant and reparameterization-invariant effective path law
exact null and endpoint controls that separate it from an endpoint lapse rewrite
analytic and numerical target-free point-lens benchmarks
a frozen response-blind differential-redshift coefficient for eight exploration lenses
the exact conservation and preferred-frame obligations of any completion

comparators.distinction: For a stationary lens, -xi_a k^a is conserved and a photon that enters and exits the same potential has no residual static path redshift; unequal paths do have lensing and Shapiro/geometric delays.

A real path effect already exists when gravitational potentials evolve. It is proportional to time variation of the metric potentials and vanishes for an exactly static lens; the proposed q_W exposure does not.
FLRW is conformally flat, so q_W is exactly zero in the homogeneous background. Multiple images share the background factor, while the proposed foreground differential remains.
Cold-plasma group delay scales approximately as frequency^-2 and may scatter or scintillate; the proposed centroid shift is achromatic.
Dust changes flux and colour rather than applying one common multiplicative shift to every narrow-line wavelength.
Static lensing changes direction, magnification, and arrival time but not the conserved stationary-lens frequency. The comparison must align source epochs by the measured time delay.
These are published GR/astrophysical causes of image-to-image spectral shifts and must be jointly modelled, not counted as evidence for path accumulation.
